show.description:
On her first day, the new CEO fires the company’s most valuable engineer—without knowing who he really is.
Now, as the empire’s core AI collapses, she must face the fallout of her biggest mistake.
A high-stakes corporate drama where power, pride, and regret collide. Watch Now !
